# @metator/plugin-typescript

<!-- metator:generated:start -->
<!-- Generated by `metator cards build` from the import graph. Edit the sections below, not this block. -->
- Directory: `packages/plugin-typescript`
- Depends on: `@metator/core`
- Test-only dependencies: `@metator/plugin-bun`, `@metator/testing`
- Used by: `@metator/runtime`
- Imported by other packages: `packages/plugin-typescript/src/index.ts`
- Third-party: `oxc-parser`, `oxc-resolver`
<!-- metator:generated:end -->

## Responsibility

`ImportAnalyzer` port on oxc: import extraction with oxc-parser, resolution with oxc-resolver (tsconfig paths, package exports, workspace links). `RuleEngine` port on the TypeScript compiler: canon rules bound to compiler checks (`tsc:noUncheckedIndexedAccess`), enabled per `tsc --showConfig`, findings from `tsc --noEmit` (ADR-0027). `SymbolAnalyzer` (exports, re-exports, imports by name) on the same oxc module record and `DeclarationEmitter` on `tsc --emitDeclarationOnly` (ADR-0040).

## Invariants

- Node builtins are external, never files [[cite: packages/plugin-typescript/src/oxc-import-analyzer.ts:135 | "if (specifier.startsWith(\"node:\")) return { type: \"external\", name: specifier };"]].

## Allowed dependencies

`@metator/core`, `oxc-parser` and `oxc-resolver` (ADR-0017); the compiler is the user's own `typescript` in `node_modules/.bin`.

## Pitfalls

- Bump `OxcImportAnalyzer.id` when `parse` extracts something new; otherwise the import index keeps serving old parses.
- CommonJS `require()` is not analyzed.
